title: Courage
competency: Explain courage and its importance, and act courageously.

keywords.def: Facing what is difficult or painful instead of avoiding it; trying again and again until you succeed.

en.text: Courage is facing what is difficult or painful instead of avoiding it, and trying again and again until you succeed. A courageous person does not lose heart after failing. Robert Bruce, inspired by a spider, won on his seventh try; Edison kept trying until the light bulb worked.

screens.title: Figure 1.4: our athletes
screens.ask: Tirunesh Dibaba and Kenenisa Bekele trained for years and lost some races. Why did they keep going?
opts: Courage: they did not give up
screens.after: Courage means trying again and again despite obstacles. That is how they became champions.

screens.title: Courage
paras: Courage is confronting what is difficult or painful rather than avoiding it.
It is being fearless or brave, and trying again and again until you succeed.
Only consistent effort leads to success. There is no shortcut.
If Thomas Edison had given up after many failures, the light bulb might not have come in 1879.

screens.title: Case study: Robert Bruce and the spider
steps: Robert Bruce of Scotland fought for his country's freedom.
He was defeated over and over, but did not give up.
In a cave he watched a spider try again and again to climb the wall.
At last the spider succeeded. Bruce took courage and fought again.
On his seventh attempt he was successful.

screens.title: Key words
defs: Facing what is difficult or painful instead of avoiding it; trying again and again until you succeed.

screens.text: What does the Robert Bruce story teach?
opts: Do not give up after failure
Success comes on the first try
screens.ans: Do not give up after failure
screens.why: He succeeded on the seventh attempt.
screens.clue: How many times did he try?

screens.text: Standing up to give a speech in front of the class requires courage.
screens.why: It means facing something many find difficult.
screens.clue: Is it hard for many people?

screens.text: A friend says unkind things about a classmate who is not there. The courageous thing is to
opts: politely ask your friend to stop
screens.ans: politely ask your friend to stop
screens.why: Courage is confronting a difficult situation instead of avoiding it.

screens.text: Liya failed her maths test twice. Which plan shows courage as the book describes it?
opts: Study a little every day and try again
screens.ans: Study a little every day and try again
screens.why: Courage is consistent effort and trying again until you succeed. Copying is dishonest, not courageous.
